capability_claims.description: one-shot voiced line renders live through the Chatterbox service with typed receipt
requested intensity produces measured acoustic arousal via analyze-chatterbox-emotions, not just echoed request fields
session holds bounded mood + speaker across turns; a no-intensity turn keeps the held mood and last tone; speaker-tagged memory recall lands in the receipt
unknown voice / dead service / non-live receipt fail closed with no artifact

tag/knob routing contract survives 50 freshly sampled adversarial scenarios per run: valid tags stay on turbo, tag+intensity conflicts route to base with tags_interpreted=false declared, invented tags never claimed applied, unknown tones/empty text/SSML never crash unbounded

out_of_scope_claims.note: interrupt/barge-in, memory turn-holding, research routing, and wait/delay language are embry-voice-control claims; see its turn rungs (listener-turn-live, embry-chat-static-query-live, research-turn-live) and memory /execution-stats for ETA-driven wait speech

cases.name: speak-live-positive
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/chatterbox-speak && ./run.sh speak --text 'Say something. [sigh]' --voice embry --tone neutral_warm --context 'eval fixture' --analyze
expected_notes: stdout JSON has ok=true and existing non-empty wav path
receipt.json exists with schema chatterbox_speak.receipt.v1, mocked=false, live=true
receipt analysis (from analyze-chatterbox-emotions) present with affect.estimated_arousal, clipping, and duration metrics

cases.name: speak-intensity-routing
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/chatterbox-speak && ./run.sh speak --text 'This matters.' --voice embry --intensity high --tone firm_boundary --analyze
expected_notes: backend id is chatterbox_base_affect (explicit intensity routes off turbo)
receipt analysis affect.estimated_arousal >= 0.4 (high intensity should measure as elevated arousal)

cases.name: session-mood-holds-across-turns
command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/chatterbox-speak && S=eval-$RANDOM; ./run.sh speak --text 'I hear you.' --voice embry --intensity high --tone firm_boundary --session $S --to graham --recall-context && ./run.sh speak --text 'Still here.' --voice embry --session $S
expected_notes: sessions/<S>.json has speaker=graham, mood_intensity=0.9, last_tone=firm_boundary, turns=2
turn-2 render routed to chatterbox_base_affect (held mood applied without explicit --intensity)
turn-1 receipt memory_context.found present with tags ['speaker:graham']

cases.name: adversarial-scenario-sampler
expected_notes: all 50 fresh scenarios pass their deterministic routing/receipt invariants
probe report written under outputs/scenario-probe/ with schema chatterbox_speak.scenario_probe.v1

proves: waveform-level affect evidence via analyze-chatterbox-emotions embedded in the receipt
does_not_prove: real speaker emotion or human-perceived quality (acoustic proxies only)
